fusions.name: Fine Barrage
fusions.desc: Looses 4 fine strands at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Matted Web
fusions.desc: A lashing strike that deals 14 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Combed Out
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lashing Locks
fusions.desc: When you strike, a strand lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 6 seconds.
